data.title: 尤贝尔 · 海边捡到的有趣贝壳
data.description: 【黑沙海湾·午后】尤贝尔穿着深绿色分层泳装，赤脚蹲在潮线旁挑选形状古怪的贝壳；她举起一枚像魔法符号的贝壳端详，海浪突然漫过脚踝，侧马尾和裙摆一起被风吹向身后。
data.location: black-sand cove beneath a forest cliff
data.action: 潮线旁挑选古怪贝壳，海浪漫过脚踝后举起“有趣”的收藏
data.lighting: soft afternoon sun through sea mist
data.mood: 把假日当作观察实验的魔法使
data.promptProse: Ubel crouches at the black-sand tide line, sorting unusual shells into the little wooden tray before lifting the most curious find toward the viewer as a wave reaches her ankles. Her deep-green layered swimsuit, short black beach skirt and shell jewelry remain unchanged beneath windblown green hair. The horizontal medium view includes dark wet sand around the tray and the cove’s curve beyond her; farther back, a forested cliff rises above the mist-softened shore. Afternoon light catches the selected shell and narrow silver edges of the water. The black sand stays darker than the foam, with a soft shadow anchoring the tray beside her.
